CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2829 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f. Bus nonce: 64c74994d5f442bb6f5d51e5f6b15bd1. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f` or `Fix review: blocked 9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 64c74994d5f442bb6f5d51e5f6b15bd1`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2829 9ddadc7666829f2550c61f1bfc9e6d7d2745aa2f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2829-64c74994`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA review of #2829 (triage batch 29, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch29.md, rulings P158-P167) at the re-cut head, against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md and dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. The previous head was blocked; the blocked verdict is attached below. THE RULE TRIAGE APPLIES, which you check on every ruling: an unmeasured benefit is DEFER; an ACCEPT stands only when it is (a) measured (the Instances: field carries the command or log reference beside each figure and you re-derive at least one), (b) measure-first (the destination group's first step is the measurement, with a removal criterion), or (c) a trial with a named measurement and a removal criterion. An even trade is REJECT. For each finding in the attached verdict, say whether the re-cut closed it, with the line that does. Re-check every ruling's Source:, Instances:, Cost:, Binding: and that every ACCEPT names a destination group that is LIVE on the roster at origin/main (exists, not done, not absorbed, not merging or in the train spool); a DEFER names a group that is not done or absorbed; a ruling that re-cuts an earlier one cites it; no ruling duplicates another or an existing group. Check the body's verdict figures against the file, that the pull request changes only the batch file and its delivery row, and that no host or home path appears. Report a ruling you would change, with the evidence, and say merge or blocked.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.

Round 1. Measured head da139892f101eada76b1b394ff6909ad80fe97eb (still the PR head at review time). Reviewed against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md, which was unchanged between merge base and origin/main.

## Block

- **P162 (V93), ACCEPT narrowed -> R10-FLY-OPENPR-ATOMIC.** The premise is wrong, and I would rule it DEFER (already enforced) or REJECT. `open_pr.sh` runs under `pr_trap` (`open_pr.sh:15`), which is `set -Eeo pipefail` with an ERR report (`pr_args.sh:32-35`). The merge at `open_pr.sh:48` (`git merge -q --no-edit origin/main`) exits non-zero on a conflicting handoff, so the script stops before `app_push.sh` creates the PR (`open_pr.sh:54-58`). Today a conflicting handoff already never becomes a PR. The carried control "a mutant that runs the check after create leaves a PR and fails" is vacuous: line 48 still stops that mutant before create. The instance does not support the mechanism either. #2817 was opened earlier and then updated several times by merging main (`refs/pull/2817/head`: merges of origin/main at 18:02 and 20:17 +0100). Its DIRTY state therefore came from main moving after the open, which an open-time check cannot catch. The only addition left is a nicer message plus a `handoff-conflict` relay line, and the ruling does not measure that benefit. Evidence: ev/p162_open_pr.txt.
- **P161 (V87), ACCEPT -> R10-FLOW-DESIGN-STAGES.** The Instances figure "4 have no Controls" does not re-derive under the rule the carry states. The carry says to refuse a group "whose brief and carries contain no `Controls` (case-insensitive, or `control:`)". On roster 63d8938eb, of the 54 not-started or queued groups (re-derived: 54), that rule refuses **14**, not 4. The extra 10 include R10-FLY-ROW-HEAD-CARRY, R10-HOUSE-GRADE, R10-ADVISOR-RESIDUE and R10-LEARNER-DEFAULT, which carry "Null control owed" and similar wording. The file's 4 come back only under a different rule, the whole word `\bcontrols?\b`. The carry's named refusal list would therefore fail the fixer's own control fixture. Fix: state the word rule in the carry, or re-count under the stated one. Also, "R10-RCA-HEADMOVED (exempt if rca)": its kind is `study`, not `rca`, so it is not exempt, and the hedge should go. Body figure "6 of 54" matches the union under the word rule only. Empty `files` = 3 re-derives exactly. Evidence: ev/p161_rederive.txt.
- **P166 (V102), "ACCEPT, no new round-10 carry".** It names no destination, but the contract requires that "ACCEPT names its destination". An item that an existing group already owns is a DEFER that names the owner. Precedent on main: `s5-batch1.md:84,126,266,348` ("DEFER -> owned by ..."). It should read DEFER -> owned by R10-LEGIONELLA-COMPLETION (brief point (3), verified on the roster), with the round-11 residue in P167's R10-ROUND-PLAYBOOK carry item (3). This also leaves the body's verdict count (10 ACCEPT) wrong once corrected (9 ACCEPT, 1 DEFER).

## Findings

- P158 cites `gate` needs `codeql` at `ci.yml:254`. Line 254 is `pr-contract`'s needs. `gate` (`ci.yml:301-302`) needs `[prelude, pr-contract]`, so the dependency is only transitive. The substance holds, but the citation is wrong; correct it in the same revision. Carry: R10-PROOF-CODEQL | dismissed: citation fix rides this PR's revision
- P158's "76 of 144 round-10 PRs skipped" carries no command or log reference (contract: "cite it, don't carry it"). I could not re-derive it from git; it needs check-run data. Cite its source or drop the figure. Carry: R10-PROOF-CODEQL | dismissed: rides this PR's revision
- P164 says the self-test arms "around `merge_train.py:4876-4890`" assert the drop and no-drop cases. Those lines assert only no-drop on a red main. The drop assertions are at `merge_train.py:4655` and `:4659`. Carry: R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE | dismissed: citation fix rides this PR's revision

All are live and own the files claimed. R10-PROOF-CODEQL is absent on main and already appended on handoff/audit-r10-roster (362a47062) as queued, files `tools/pr/codeql_scope.py`, `tools/ci/prelude.py`. ev/destinations.txt.
- Citations re-read at dfcd8d9be and found to hold: `codeql_scope.py:29-31`, `prelude.py:226` and `:343-344`, `merge_train.py:5435`, `ledger.py:90-98`, `cloud_relay.sh:101-105`, `orchestrator_tick.py:844-848` with `merge_train.dirty_repair` (line 469), `pr_args.sh:66`, `update_pr.sh:35`, `open_pr.sh:34`.
